title: Enrichment of Membrane Proteins for Downstream Analysis Using SMALPs Extraction
author: Benedict Dirnberger
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML

steps.title: Prepare all buffers and solutions
steps.instruction: Make isotonic lysis buffer (0.25 M sucrose, 50 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.4, 10 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 2 mM EDTA, protease inhibitor), 5 % SMALP solution (5 % styrene‑maleic acid copolymer, 5 mM Tris‑Base, 0.15 mM NaCl, pH 8.0), coupling buffer (0.1 M NaHCO₃, 0.5 M NaCl, pH 8.3), Tris‑buffer/TBS (50 mM Tris, 150 mM NaCl, pH 8.0), TBS‑T (add Tween‑20 to 0.1 % v/v), blocking solution (5 % skimmed milk in TBS‑T), Laemmli buffer (1 M Tris pH 6.8, 10 % SDS, 5 % glycerol, 2 % bromophenol blue), sample buffer (98 % HPLC water, 2 % ACN, 0.1 % FA), and Coomassie staining solution (0.1 % w/v Coomassie G‑250, 5 % w/v aluminum sulfate‑(14‑18)‑hydrate, 10 % v/v methanol, 2 % v/v ortho‑phosphoric acid).

steps.title: Freeze and sieve fly heads
steps.instruction: In a 50 mL Falcon tube, place ~6 g (≈6 000 flies) of adult D. melanogaster, freeze rapidly in liquid nitrogen, vortex 3 min, cool 30 s on liquid N₂, vortex again 3 min. Transfer frozen flies onto a pre‑cooled 800 µm sieve, then onto a 400 µm sieve to separate heads from bodies. Collect heads; store at –80 °C if not used immediately.

steps.title: Lyse heads in isotonic buffer
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL isotonic lysis buffer to ~0.8 g heads, vortex three times, then homogenize with 60 strokes using a 2 mL Dounce homogenizer (pestle).

steps.title: Differential centrifugation to isolate membranes
steps.instruction: Perform all spins in a 4 °C refrigerated centrifuge:

substeps.instruction: Pre‑cellular clearance: 200 × g, 5 min; discard pellet.
After each spin, transfer supernatant to a new tube and keep the pellet for later western‑blot analysis.

steps.title: Identify plasma‑membrane‑enriched fraction by western blot
steps.instruction: Run each pellet on a 4 %–15 % SDS‑PAGE, transfer to a 0.2 µm nitrocellulose membrane, block with 5 % skimmed milk in TBS‑T for 16 h at 4 °C, incubate 16 h at 4 °C with anti‑ATPase α1 antibody (1:1000 in blocking solution), wash, incubate 1 h with anti‑mouse ECL‑peroxidase (1:??), develop with ECL solution for 10 s on CL‑XPosure film. The fraction showing strongest ATPase signal is used for SMALP extraction. For nAChR verification, treat samples (±1 % DTT), boil 60 °C 8 min, run SDS‑PAGE, transfer, block, incubate 16 h at 4 °C with anti‑GFP (1:1000), wash, incubate 1 h with anti‑rat IgG, develop as above.

steps.title: Form SMALPs from membrane pellets
steps.instruction: Resuspend the chosen plasma‑membrane pellet (24–177 mg wet weight) in 20–300 µL 5 % SMALP solution, incubate 2 h at room temperature on a rocking platform to allow nanodisc formation.

steps.title: Ultracentrifuge to collect SMALP supernatant
steps.instruction: Spin the SMALP mixture at 100,000 × g for 60 min at 4 °C; collect the supernatant (contains SMALPs) for downstream work. Keep on ice; avoid freezing.

steps.title: Prepare α‑BTX‑coupled Sepharose beads
steps.instruction: Hydrate 0.25 g CNBr‑activated Sepharose in 1.25 mL 1 mM HCl for 1 h at 4 °C on a rotator. Centrifuge 1,500 × g 5 min, discard supernatant, wash twice with 1 mL coupling buffer, centrifuge each wash 1,500 × g 5 min. Resuspend 1 mg α‑BTX in 1 mL coupling buffer, add beads, rotate 16 h at 4 °C. Centrifuge 1,500 × g 5 min, keep supernatant for coupling‑efficiency assay (Pierce quantitative fluorometric peptide kit). Block beads with 1 mL 0.2 M glycine in 80 % coupling buffer, 16 h at 4 °C, rotate. Centrifuge 1,500 × g 5 min, wash sequentially: 1 mL 0.1 M NaHCO₃, 0.5 M NaCl, pH 8.0; 1 mL 0.1 M NaCH₃CO₂, 0.5 M NaCl, pH 4.0; repeat NaHCO₃ wash. Final wash with coupling buffer, then incubate beads twice for 30 min in 1 mL Tris‑buffer (50 mM Tris, 150 mM NaCl, pH 8.0). Centrifuge 1,500 × g 5 min and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Pull‑down nAChRs with α‑BTX beads
steps.instruction: Incubate 800–1000 µL SMALP extract (20–35 mg mL⁻¹, measured by NanoDrop) with 200 µL α‑BTX‑Sepharose beads for 16 h at 4 °C on a rotator. Centrifuge 1,500 × g 5 min, wash beads 2–3 times with 1 mL ice‑cold TBS (10 min each wash on rotator at 4 °C). Centrifuge 1,500 × g 5 min after each wash. Elute bound nAChRs twice with 100 µL 1 M carbachol, rotating at room temperature. Centrifuge 1,500 × g 5 min; transfer supernatant to a fresh tube.

steps.title: Precipitate and resuspend proteins for SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Add ice‑cold 100 % acetone (4 × sample volume) to eluate, vortex, precipitate 16 h at –20 °C. Centrifuge 13,000 × g 15 min, discard supernatant, dissolve pellet in Laemmli buffer, heat 60 °C 8 min. Load onto Mini‑Protean TGX precast gels and run per manufacturer.

steps.title: Coomassie stain gels
steps.instruction: Fix gels 60 min in 40 % (v/v) ethanol + 10 % (v/v) acetic acid, wash twice with water 10 min each. Stain 16 h in Coomassie solution (0.1 % w/v Coomassie G‑250, 5 % w/v aluminum sulfate‑(14‑18)‑hydrate, 10 % v/v methanol, 2 % v/v ortho‑phosphoric acid). Destain as needed.

steps.title: In‑gel digestion for LC‑MS
steps.instruction: Excise protein bands, place gel pieces in 50 mM NH₄HCO₃/50 % ACN, vortex 10 min (V‑32 mixer, max speed). Remove supernatant, add 100 % ACN, repeat, then dry 20 min in speed‑vac. Reduce with 10 mM DTT in 50 mM NH₄HCO₃, 56 °C 1 h. Remove DTT, alkylate with 50 mM IAA in 50 mM NH₄HCO₃, RT 45 min in dark. Wash: add 50 mM NH₄HCO₃, vortex 5 min, centrifuge, discard; add 100 % ACN, vortex 10 min, discard; repeat wash, dry 20 min. Add Trypsin/Lys‑C mix (per manufacturer) on ice 45 min. Add 30 µL 25 mM NH₄HCO₃, incubate 37 °C 16 h. Extract peptides: add 20 mM NH₄HCO₃, vortex 10 min, collect supernatant; add 50 % ACN/5 % FA, vortex 20 min, collect; repeat ACN/FA extraction once more. Combine all extracts, dry in speed‑vac, store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Desalt peptides on C‑18 stage tips
steps.instruction: Prepare C‑18 stage tip (three C‑18 plugs in a 200 µL pipette tip). Equilibrate with 100 µL methanol/0.1 % FA, centrifuge 2 min at max speed, discard flowthrough. Add 100 µL 70 % ACN/0.1 % FA, centrifuge 2 min, discard. Add 100 µL 0.1 % FA, centrifuge 2 min, discard; repeat. Transfer tip to a clean 2 mL tube, resuspend dried peptide pellet in 20 µL 0.1 % FA, vortex 15 min. Load peptide solution onto tip, centrifuge 2–5 s at ~1,000 rpm to bind. Incubate 5 min RT, centrifuge 2,000 × g 5 min. Reload flowthrough onto tip and repeat binding step. Wash tip twice with 100 µL 0.1 % FA, centrifuge 2 min each. Elute peptides with 70 % ACN/0.1 % FA into a low‑binding tube, centrifuge 2,000 × g 5 min. Dry eluate in speed‑vac, store at –20 °C; re‑suspend in 0.1 % FA before LC‑MS.

steps.title: LC‑MS/MS acquisition
steps.instruction: Dissolve peptides in 20 µL 0.1 % FA; inject ~1 µg per run. Use Dionex Ultimate 3000 RSLC nanoUPLC coupled to Q Exactive Orbitrap. Load onto a PepMap 100 C18 pre‑column (5 µm, 100 Å, 300 µm × 5 mm) at 15 µL min⁻¹ with 0.1 % FA for 3 min. Switch valve to analytical column (PepMap C18, 2 µm, 100 Å, 75 µm × 50 cm). Separate at 300 nL min⁻¹ with gradient 2 %–40 % solvent B (80 % ACN, 20 % water, 0.1 % FA) over 90 min (total run 120 min). Use Easy‑spray source, 2.1 kV spray voltage. MS1: Orbitrap resolution 35 000, scan 380–1500 m/z. Data‑dependent Top‑20 MS/MS: HCD NCE 25 %, resolution 17 500, exclude singly charged and unassigned ions, dynamic exclusion 20 s. Wash columns ≥4 times between runs.
